full_prompt_en: A square pointillist painted portrait shows the head of a moustached man in close three-quarter profile against a softly mottled pale background. His face turns toward the image left, though the nearer eye glances outward so the viewer can meet the gaze. Dark wavy hair gathers across the upper right and is cropped by the top edge. A strong brow, long pointed nose, curled dark moustache, and firm chin give the face a distinctive angular structure. The mouth is small and closed beneath the moustache; the visible ear sits at the far right, partly merging into cooler shadow. A narrow pale collar or cloth edge appears at the lower right, with the neck continuing out of frame. Rather than smooth blended skin, the forehead, cheek, nose, and jaw are composed of dense tiny touches in cream, yellow, salmon, turquoise, blue, violet, and brown. Warm colors cluster along the illuminated nose and cheek, while cool purple-blue points gather under the eye, around the ear, and beneath the jaw. The pale background carries the same granular mark-making in lower contrast, so the silhouette emerges through changes in density and hue rather than a hard outline. The camera-like crop magnifies the dots until they remain individually visible even as they merge optically into facial form. Soft light seems to arrive from the upper left, brightening the forehead and nose while the far side deepens into cool shadow. The overall composition is intimate and analytical, using a vibrating field of colored marks to hold a calm, serious expression.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形点彩肖像画呈现一位留胡子的男子，头部以近距离四分之三侧面出现在柔和斑驳的浅色背景前。面孔转向画面左侧，靠近观者的眼睛却向外瞥，使视线能够相遇。深色波浪发聚在右上方，并被上边缘裁切。浓眉、长而尖的鼻子、卷曲深胡子和结实下巴赋予面孔鲜明棱角结构。胡须下方嘴小且闭合，可见耳朵位于最右处，部分融入较冷阴影。右下方露出窄浅色衣领或布边，脖颈延续到画外。额头、面颊、鼻子及下颌并非平滑晕开的皮肤，而由奶油色、黄、鲑粉、青绿、蓝、紫与褐色的密集小笔点组成。暖色沿受光的鼻子与脸颊聚集，冷紫蓝色点则位于眼下、耳周与下颌下。浅色背景以较低反差承载同样的颗粒笔法，因此剪影靠密度与色相变化而非硬轮廓浮现。摄影式近裁切放大色点，使它们在光学上合成面部形体时仍能逐个看见。柔光似从左上方到来，照亮额头与鼻子，远侧则深入冷影。整体构图亲密而细察，以振动的彩色笔点承载平静、严肃的表情。
style_prompt_en: The image has a pointillist painted surface made of densely placed small color marks rather than smooth blends. Cream and yellow highlights mingle with salmon, turquoise, violet, and deep blue-brown shadows; neighboring hues mix in the eye while remaining individually visible. Form emerges from changing dot density and temperature, with only a few dark accents defining the strongest features. The surrounding field carries the same grain at lower contrast, softening the transition from focal shape to background. Gentle upper-side light makes warmer patches advance and cooler ones recede. Close cropping reveals the physical rhythm of the marks. The overall effect is luminous and vibrating yet quietly controlled, with optical color doing the modeling.
style_prompt_zh: 画面是由密集小色痕而非平滑晕染构成的点彩绘画表面。奶油和黄亮部与鲑粉、青绿、紫及深蓝褐阴影交错；相邻色在眼中混合，单个笔点仍可见。形体从色点密度与冷暖变化中出现，只有少量深色强调界定最强特征。周围底域以较低反差承载同样颗粒，使焦点形状向背景的过渡柔和。上方偏侧的柔光让暖色斑前进、冷色斑后退。近裁切显露笔点的实体节奏。整体效果发亮而振动，却仍安静受控，主要以视觉混色塑造形体。
theme_en: A pointillist close portrait of a moustached man seen in three-quarter profile
theme_zh: 一位留胡子男子四分之三侧面的点彩近景肖像
name: Pointillism
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
